SUBJECT: REQUEST FOR FORWARDING A COPY OF A RECORD (MEDIATION DOCUMENT)

For the case identified below, please forward one copy of the record (mediation document), which is required for the grant of a writ of execution, by 19____ . ____ . ____ .

? PARTICULARS ?

[Official seal]

NOTE 1: In the "Case" field, enter the case number stated on the mediation record, etc., for which a writ of execution is requested. Example: Year ____ No. ____.
NOTE 2: Article 6 of the Rules on Granting Writs of Execution on Mediation Records, etc. of Various Dispute Resolution Committees, etc.

The extracted form identifies these fields, dates, receipt and approval boxes, official seal, notes and legal reference. The exact printed grid and position of vertical entries require comparison with the original attachment.
